content.value: Annual rainfall in a location is 1600 mm. Survey report says that the total catchment 12 area can be 120 km2 and the effective head expected to be 28 m. Load factor forecasted to be 40%. Runoff and evaporation loss is allowed by a yield factor of 50%. The plant to be installed has design efficiency at 28 m head of 80%. Determine- (i) the average power that can be produced and (ii) plant capacity that can be installed.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2022
